name: Kirishima Reiichi
source: The protagonist. Has handsome looks, and as such he is popular among the girls. He's a boy who understands the feelings of people and always ready to help them. He's usually joking and playing with others, but has good science knowledge. By chance, he succeeds in his development of an artificial intelligence – "Apeiria."
